title: The Journey of an Application File
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: A swimlane flowchart that walks an application through an admissions office, showing who touches the file at each of seven steps.

educational.topic: The Journey of an Application File
learningObjectives: Students will explain the path an application takes through an admissions office and summarize the role of the admissions officer at each step.
prerequisites: Chapter 1: The College Landscape and Application Rounds

keyQuestions: Why is a file not 'complete' until operations staff have matched every document?
What does the first reader write, and who reads it next?
How does the path differ at a formula-based public university?
commonMisconceptions: A computer or a single person decides every application.
Missing documents are the college's problem to chase; in fact the file sits incomplete until they arrive.
assessmentOpportunities: Students describe the path of a file in order and name the role of the first reader at the first-read and committee steps.
